text:
Tom (Support): FYI customer BlueCart flagged duplicate invoice delivery: two files with same invoice id but different amounts. invoice id: BC-2026-0503-99. Customer says one PDF shows vendor marketplace fee $2.50 and the other doesn't; totals are $42.50 vs $40.00. They attached both PDFs.

Nina (Billing): ouch. can you drop the invoice id and the customer email so i can look?

Tom (Support): invoice=BC-2026-0503-99, customer=accounts@bluecart.co. They received final.pdf and final_copy.pdf.

OpsBot: [automated] invoice_emit job 2026-05-03T08:12:05Z started, run=emit_20260503_0812

BillingBot: [automated] s3_put events: put(final.pdf) -> 08:12:18Z, put(final_copy.pdf) -> 08:12:20Z

Arjun (Finance): pulling DB rows: `select id, external_id, amount_cents, status, emitted_files from invoices where external_id='BC-2026-0503-99';` returns two rows: `id=8132 amount_cents=4250 status=emitted files=[final.pdf]` and `id=8133 amount_cents=4000 status=emitted files=[final_copy.pdf]`

Nina (Billing): how did we create two invoice rows with same external_id? we should have a uniqueness constraint.

Arjun (Finance): looks like the insertion used run_id as part of dedupe key earlier this month and a race happened when two parallel workers retried emission after a transient mapping error. logs:
```
line_mapper: INFO mapping vendor_fee -> sku_vendor_fee
line_mapper: WARN conflict: sku_vendor_fee already reserved by job emit_20260503_0811, fallback=drop_line
pdf_emitter: INFO emit_pdf id=8132 final.pdf
pdf_emitter: WARN retry_emission detected, emitted_copy final_copy.pdf
s3_client: DEBUG eventual_consistency_delay detected for key=BC-2026-0503-99/final.pdf
```

Tom (Support): customer insists they did not trigger anything on their side. they're worried about duplicate charges.

Ruth (Legal): compliance note: we can't alter invoice numbers; if two invoices exist we should void the incorrect one and issue a credit. we need audit trail.

Nina (Billing): proposed ops: 1) temporarily suspend public access to both PDFs in S3, 2) mark the lower-amount invoice id=8133 as voided and create credit CR-2026-00512 for $40.00, 3) keep the correct invoice id=8132 for audit but mark as canonical, 4) send corrected statement email to BlueCart with explanation and CR attached.

Arjun (Finance): additionally we should run a consistency job to find invoices where external_id appears >1 and flag them. I'll run a quick query and schedule a backfill.

OpsBot: [automated] cleanup_task queued: cleanup_emit_duplicates_2965551234 by Nina

Nina (Billing): quick customer update draft: "Hi BlueCart — we saw two PDFs were accidentally published due to an internal emission race. We've voided the duplicate, issued a credit (CR-2026-00512), and the canonical invoice (BC-2026-0503-99) shows the vendor marketplace fee of $2.50. We're attaching the audit log and steps taken. Apologies for the confusion." ok?

Tom (Support): please cc legal and paste the audit log. customer asked for a short root-cause note.

Ruth (Legal): cc legal OK. confirm credit reference in email. Also ask whether they want a corrected invoice number or prefer the credit + canonical invoice.

Arjun (Finance): root cause summary for CS: race in emission workers where a mapping conflict triggered a fallback to drop the vendor_fee line in one worker, causing divergent invoice body; both workers emitted PDFs and insertion logic allowed duplicate external_id rows during retries. Fixes: add unique index on invoices.external_id -> fail-fast on insert, change line_mapper to error on mapping conflict (no silent drop), and add s3 put dedupe guard with object-lock key. I'll open PRs and schedule for next deploy window.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup_task cleanup_emit_duplicates_2965551234 started at 12:41Z

Nina (Billing): cleanup done: id=8133 voided, credit issued CR-2026-00512, public PDFs removed. new customer email sent.

Tom (Support): bluecart replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick fix. Please keep us posted on how you will prevent this."

Arjun (Finance): follow-ups: DB migration ticket FIN-MIG-221 to add unique index + backfill to detect duplicates; QA ticket Q-9901 to add emission concurrency tests; Ops ticket OPS-317 to add s3 put-idempotency. ETA for fixes: next deploy (3 business days).

Ruth (Legal): please include a one-paragraph consumer-friendly root cause in the email thread and attach audit. good job closing quickly.

Nina (Billing): closing here, will post incident summary in #finance-docs with timelines and CR/INV references.

BillingBot: [automated] cleanup_task complete at 12:57Z, status=success
